FX-KERNEL-001.says: The grid as it starts, the middle pixel alone, divider 1: the drawing, untouched.

FX-KERNEL-002.says: All nine 1, divider 9: each pixel the average of itself and its eight neighbours, a soft blur; the columns' edges soften and the empty column darkens its neighbour.

FX-KERNEL-003.says: 0 -1 0 / -1 5 -1 / 0 -1 0, divider 1: a sharpen; flat areas stay, each column's edge gets a light and a dark rim.

FX-KERNEL-004.says: -1 all round, 8 in the middle, divider 1, absolute values off: edges only; flat areas turn black, and where a pixel is darker than its neighbours the negative result is black too.

FX-KERNEL-005.says: The same edge grid, absolute values on: the negative results turn positive, so both sides of every edge light up.

FX-KERNEL-006.says: -2 -1 0 / -1 1 1 / 0 1 2, divider 1: an emboss, lit from the lower right; it shows the grid is read with line 1 above and each line's first number on the left.

FX-KERNEL-007.says: Only line 2's first number, 1: every pixel takes the colour of the pixel to its left, so the picture moves one pixel right; the first shown column takes the empty column's 0, black.

FX-KERNEL-008.says: Only line 1's middle number, 1: every pixel takes the colour of the pixel above, so the picture moves one pixel down; the top row repeats.

FX-KERNEL-009.says: The middle pixel alone, divider 2: every colour's encoded value halved.

FX-KERNEL-010.says: The middle pixel alone, divider 0.5: every colour's encoded value doubled, held at white.

FX-KERNEL-011.says: Middle number 4, divider keyed from 4 at frame 0 to 1 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 every value times 1.6, frame 4 times 4, held at white.

FX-KERNEL-012.says: FX-KERNEL-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-KERNEL-013.says: Line 1's first number 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KERNEL-014.says: Line 2 with two numbers, not three. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KERNEL-015.says: Divider 0, below 0.01. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KERNEL-016.says: Divider 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KERNEL-017.says: Absolute values "yes", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KERNEL-018.says: Absolute values "ON": the word is exact, so capitals are not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
